assets.name: book-two-chapter-03-rooftop-talk
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Correct ONLY the two human HEADS and eye masks in image 1, the costume rooftop conversation. This needs a visibly substantial FACIAL REDRAW, not subtle recoloring or hair-only changes. Image 2 is Seth's authoritative civilian face (red hoodie, top tutoring panel); image 3 is Jenny's authoritative civilian face at the typewriter. Transfer those facial identities into image 1. Replace the enormous round cartoon eye whites with eyes about 40 percent SMALLER in height, shaped like the references: almond-shaped openings, distinct upper and lower eyelids, blue irises with small black circular pupils, upper lids partly covering irises. Give Jenny her reference's more mature defined cheeks, nose, lips, narrower jaw and expressive natural-size eyes. Give Seth his reference's youthful slim tapered face, visible nose bridge, defined chin, natural eyebrows and modest blue eyes; he remains a young recent graduate, no aged face or muscular jaw. Their eyes must not fill their masks. REDRAW THE WHITE AND RED EYE MASKS as narrow cloth around smaller almond-shaped openings; there must be skin visible between eyes, nose and mouth. Masks change clothing only, not identity/anatomy. Hair remains Jenny long golden-blonde waves and Seth messy side-swept brown. Keep smiles/gaze directed toward one another. Preserve all other pixels as closely as possible: bodies, costumes from neck down, gloves, parapet, background, lighting, posture, elbow contact, landscape framing, story moment. Keep Book One hand-inked illustrated style and fine hatching. No giant round eye whites, baby face, chibi, caricature, 3D, photorealism or speech. Produce one finished replacement with an unmistakable smaller-eye/face correction.
assets.visual_review: Human eyes visibly reduced to narrower almond shapes with defined lids and tighter masks; original panel actions and costumes retained. Final image inspected.
